title: Product difference bound
statement: For real numbers $a,b,c,d$ with $b\ge 0$ and $c\ge 0$, one has $\lvert ab-cd\rvert\le \lvert a-c\rvert b+c\lvert b-d\rvert$.
replaced:
Let $a, b, c, d \in \bbr$ with $b \ge 0$ and $c \ge 0$. Then
\[
\abs{ab - cd} \;\le\; \abs{a - c}\, b + c\, \abs{b - d}.
\]
